measured_by_controller: 3 reps under gpu_lane_lock.sh on merged main, both fields from the same runs
THE_INVERSION: This morning gpu_matvec was 867 ms of a 1376 ms token - 63.0 percent, and the model was compute-dominated in appearance. Now it is 39.2 of 108.3 - 36.2 percent. HOST WORK IS AGAIN THE MAJORITY at 63.8 percent, exactly as it was before the reconstruction fix inverted it.
why_that_is_not_a_regression: gpu_matvec fell from 867 to 39 ms in absolute terms, a 22x cut. The share rose only because the non-GPU side fell less far, and because the DeltaNet port's fused suffix CB is now ATTRIBUTED to the gpu_matvec bucket - the rebase lane flagged that explicitly as accounting rather than a matvec change.
what_it_aims_next: 69.1 ms of the 108.3 ms token is still outside gpu_matvec. The named candidates from the last decomposition were residual host_preparation ~25 ms (an autonomous lane is on it now), weight_addressing 18.6 and moe_routed 14.0 - which sum to about 58 ms and would plausibly account for most of the non-GPU side. But that table is STALE against this measurement, so those figures are indicative, not budgeted.
honest_caveat: This is a two-field split, not a decomposition. It says how much is gpu_matvec and how much is not; it does not attribute the 69.1 ms. Only a re-run of the 14-component ledger on current main can do that, and it is the single most useful next measurement for G003.
